note: Source packs live in the Downloads folder; scripts/build-weapons.py extracts what it needs. scale: multiply the mesh before placing it (older packs exported in centimetres). grip: metres to raise the weapon along its length before placing it in the hand (for meshes whose origin is at the pommel). hand: "l" holds the weapon in the left hand (bows). objects: mesh objects to keep from an FBX that holds several weapons. props: plain GLBs (the arrow projectile). Recolors are one mesh under another pack palette; only palettes that visibly change the weapon are used.

weapons.description: A practice sword of hard oak. It does not cut, which is not the same as not hurting.

weapons.name: Jade Gate Katana
weapons.description: A long curved blade folded a thousand times, worn edge-up. Drawn and cutting in one motion.

weapons.name: Shogun's Katana
weapons.description: The general's own blade, its tsuba worked in gold. It has ended more arguments than it has begun.

weapons.name: Kanabo
weapons.description: A studded iron-bound club as tall as a man's chest. Subtle it is not.

weapons.name: Oni's Kanabo
weapons.description: A great iron club with a demon's face at the head. Doors do not stop it.

weapons.name: Ashigaru Yari
weapons.description: A plain straight-bladed spear, the footsoldier's arm. Long reach and no manners.

weapons.name: Jumonji Yari
weapons.description: A cross-bladed spear with a lacquered shaft; the side blades hook a guard away as it thrusts.

weapons.name: Naginata
weapons.description: A curved sword blade on a long pole. It sweeps, cuts and keeps everyone at a distance.

weapons.name: Crimson Naginata
weapons.description: A temple guard's naginata with a red-lacquered shaft and a blade that has never been allowed to dull.

weapons.name: Bo
weapons.description: A plain staff of red oak, six feet of it. The monks say a weapon that cannot cut teaches restraint.

weapons.name: Vault Spear
weapons.description: A bronze-headed spear from the dwarven racks. Plain, straight and long enough.

weapons.name: Gilded Spear
weapons.description: A vault spear with a gilt collar under the head. The dwarves gild what they are proud of.

weapons.name: Silvered Pike
weapons.description: A slim pike with a silvered leaf head. Made for a wall of them.

weapons.name: Forge Lance
weapons.description: A long lance with a broad steel head. The forge guards carry these on the gantries.

weapons.name: Axe-Spear
weapons.description: A spear with an axe blade set behind the point. Thrust, then chop.

weapons.name: Deep Partisan
weapons.description: A short-bladed partisan on a dark shaft. Carried in the low tunnels where a long spear catches.

weapons.name: Gold Winged Spear
weapons.description: A ceremonial spear with gilded wings at the socket. Ceremonial means nobody expected it to be used.

weapons.name: Forge Lord's Spear
weapons.description: Broad, heavy and rune-cut along the blade. The Forge Lord's honour guard carried a dozen; this is one.

weapons.name: Boar Fork
weapons.description: A two-pronged hunting fork on a long pole. Holds a boar off; holds a man off too.

weapons.name: Levy Spear
weapons.description: The kingdom's standard issue: an ash pole and a leaf blade. Thousands were made.

weapons.name: Sergeant's Spear
weapons.description: A levy spear with a broader head and a leather grip. Sergeants got the better ones.

weapons.name: Winged Spear
weapons.description: Two lugs below the blade stop it going in too deep. Somebody learned that the hard way.

weapons.name: Ranseur
weapons.description: A three-pointed head: one blade to thrust, two to catch and twist a sword away.

weapons.name: Iron Pike
weapons.description: A long pike with a small iron head. Cheap to make and terrible to walk into.

weapons.name: Azure Spear
weapons.description: A household spear with a blue-bound shaft and a bright blade.

weapons.name: Knight's Lance
weapons.description: A heavy lance meant for the saddle. On foot it is simply a very long, very sharp argument.

weapons.name: Gilt Partisan
weapons.description: A broad partisan blade with gilt fittings, the palace guard's pattern.

weapons.name: Barbed Spear
weapons.description: A spear whose head is barbed like a fish hook. Coming out hurts more than going in.

weapons.name: Great Pike
weapons.description: The longest spear in the kingdom's armoury. Reach that nothing on two legs can answer.

weapons.name: Hunting Spear
weapons.description: A short, stout spear with a crossbar. A woodsman's tool that doubles as a weapon.

weapons.name: Knuckle Dagger
weapons.description: A short blade on a fist grip. There is no way to hold it that is not a punch.

weapons.name: Raider's Spear
weapons.description: A northern spear with a long ash shaft and a narrow head. The raiders' first weapon, before they earned an axe.

weapons.name: Jarl's Spear
weapons.description: A broad-bladed spear with a wrapped grip. Odin carried one; the Jarl carries this.

weapons.name: Hewing Spear
weapons.description: A spear with a blade long enough to cut. Thrust, then swing.

weapons.name: Fishing Spear
weapons.description: A barbed fork for the shallows. It works on things that are not fish.

weapons.name: Goblin Pig-Sticker
weapons.description: A crooked pole with a rusty blade lashed on. Goblins do not make spears, they assemble them.

weapons.name: Skull-Spear
weapons.description: A long spear with a spiked skull under the blade. The skull is decorative. The spike is not.

weapons.name: Halberd
weapons.description: Axe blade, spike and hook on a long haft. The castle guard's weapon: it does everything, none of it gently.

weapons.name: Rune Scythe
weapons.description: A reaper's scythe with a rune-lit blade from the Fortress vaults. It was not made for wheat.

weapons.name: Paired Sai
weapons.description: A sai with its sheath, black iron and red cord. Carried in pairs; one is enough.

weapons.name: Sylvan Blade
weapons.description: A straight elven sword with a leaf-shaped guard. Light in the hand and long in the reach.

weapons.name: Moonsteel Sword
weapons.description: A slim blade of pale moon-forged steel. It does not rust and it does not forgive.

weapons.name: Warden's Broadsword
weapons.description: A wide-bladed sword with a channelled edge. The forest wardens' pattern.

weapons.name: Thornwood Greatsword
weapons.description: A great two-handed elven blade with a fuller running its length. Heavy for elven work, and elven work is never heavy.

weapons.name: Stagheart Cleaver
weapons.description: A vast leaf-bladed sword, the Stagheart guard's. It falls like a felled tree.

weapons.name: Duskwood Sabre
weapons.description: A curved elven sabre with a dark wooden grip. Made for the paths at dusk.

weapons.name: Autumn Scimitar
weapons.description: A deeply curved blade with fittings in autumn bronze. It cuts on the draw.

weapons.name: Leaf Dagger
weapons.description: A slender elven dagger shaped like a willow leaf. Silent in and silent out.

weapons.name: Twin-Leaf Dirk
weapons.description: A dirk with a forked blade. Both edges are the sharp one.

weapons.name: Sylvan Sickle-Knife
weapons.description: A hooked knife with a wooden grip. A gardener's blade that took up other work.

weapons.name: Moonsteel Kris
weapons.description: A waved blade of pale steel. The wave is not for show; the wound does not close.

weapons.name: Warden's Knife
weapons.description: A plain elven knife with a bound grip. Every warden carries one.

weapons.name: Crescent Dagger
weapons.description: A blade curved into a half-moon. It catches a sword and takes the hand behind it.

weapons.name: Autumn Twinblade
weapons.description: Two blades on one grip, bronze and green. Held at the middle, it is two weapons.

weapons.name: Thorn Dagger
weapons.description: A short curved dagger the colour of thorns. Kept in the sleeve.

weapons.name: Duskwood Talon
weapons.description: A hooked dagger with a dark grip. It pulls as it cuts.

weapons.name: Crescent Axe
weapons.description: An elven axe with a single moon-curved blade. Elegant, for an axe.

weapons.name: Twin Crescent Axe
weapons.description: Two moon blades back to back. Whichever way it swings, an edge arrives.

weapons.name: Sylvan Battleaxe
weapons.description: A long-hafted axe with a leaf-cut blade. Made for the wardens who prefer weight.

weapons.name: Thornwood Poleaxe
weapons.description: A great axe on a two-metre haft, blade and spike. It clears a path.

weapons.name: Moonsteel Axe
weapons.description: A pale-bladed axe of moon-forged steel with a green heart in the blade.

weapons.name: Warden's Hatchet
weapons.description: A short axe with a broad blade. It splits kindling and skulls with equal patience.

weapons.name: Autumn Hand-Axe
weapons.description: A one-hand axe in autumn bronze. Light enough to throw; better not to.

weapons.name: Sylvan Glaive
weapons.description: A wide curved blade on a short pole. It sweeps low and comes back high.

weapons.name: Moonlit Twin-Glaive
weapons.description: A blade at either end of a long shaft. Spun, it is a wall; stopped, it is a spear.

weapons.name: Grove Maul
weapons.description: A heavy elven hammer with a green-stone head. The groves are quiet after it passes.

weapons.name: Sentinel's Spear
weapons.description: A long elven spear with a slender leaf head. The Sentinels stand with these at the forest's edge.

weapons.name: Gravewarden Sword
weapons.description: A long grey sword with a heavy guard. It was buried with its owner, who did not stay buried.

weapons.name: Bloodletter Blade
weapons.description: A dark greatsword with a blade the colour of old blood. It has never been washed.

weapons.name: Crypt Shortsword
weapons.description: A plain short sword from a crypt niche. The rust comes off; the cold does not.

weapons.name: Sepulchre Axe
weapons.description: A great axe with a skull-crested head and a shaft as long as a grave is deep.

weapons.name: Barrow Axe
weapons.description: A one-hand axe with a broad iron blade, taken from a barrow. It remembers.

weapons.name: Headsman's Cleaver
weapons.description: A square-bladed executioner's cleaver. One stroke was the contract.

weapons.name: Crypt Mace
weapons.description: A flanged iron mace from the crypt guard. Heavy, cold and indifferent.

weapons.name: Plaguebearer
weapons.description: A mace with a red-glassed head that seems to breathe. Do not put it near your face.

weapons.name: Gravedigger's Hammer
weapons.description: A long-hafted hammer with a pick at the back. It digs holes and fills them.

weapons.name: Crypt Halberd
weapons.description: A halberd with a broad axe head and a long spike, the crypt guard's.

weapons.name: Gilded Poleaxe
weapons.description: A poleaxe with a gilt axe head and a hooked back. A lord's guard carried it; the lord is dust.

weapons.name: Bone Spear
weapons.description: A polearm with a narrow bone-white blade. It is not bone. Probably.

weapons.name: Reaper's Scythe
weapons.description: A curved scythe blade on a bent iron shaft. Whose it was is not a question with a good answer.

weapons.name: Grave Sickle
weapons.description: A short iron sickle from a crypt offering table. It still cuts.

weapons.name: Odachi
weapons.description: A field sword longer than a man is tall, carried across the back and drawn with both hands. One cut is the whole fight.

weapons.name: Ninjato
weapons.description: A straight short sword with a square guard. Plain, black and quick.

weapons.name: Tonfa
weapons.description: A hardwood baton with a side handle. It guards the forearm and breaks the other one.

weapons.name: Village Knife
weapons.description: A broad utility knife from a rice village. It has cut more rope than throats, so far.

weapons.name: Prism Lance
weapons.description: A bright two-handed spear. Long reach, a heavy thrust and every colour at once.

weapons.name: Dusk Lance
weapons.description: An alternate palette for the same balanced spear. A different look, equal power.

weapons.name: Dawn Lance
weapons.description: The prism lance in the colors of first light.

weapons.name: Tide Lance
weapons.description: The prism lance in deep sea blues.

weapons.name: Verdant Lance
weapons.description: The prism lance in forest greens.
